section_summary.extract_value: This short section (3.1) describes the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS): a 14-image, computer-generated greyscale set of figures (no facial features) varying only in breast size. Participants rated the figure matching their current and their ideal breast size; the computation of a breast size dissatisfaction score is reported elsewhere in the Results. The section contains no information on sample size, demographics, BMI, body appreciation measures (BAS/BAS-2), survey method, country, or number of studies.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants were asked to complete the BSRS, which consists of 14 computer-generated images of women varying in breast size alone. The images are presented without facial features and in greyscale to minimise the impact of perceived ethnicity. Participants were asked to rate the figure that most closely represented their current breast size and the figure that most closely represented their ideal breast size (1 = figure with the smallest breast size, 14 = figure with the largest breast size). Breast size dissatisfaction score computation is described in the Results.
